info.title: Paer Quotations API
info.description: FX and cross-border payment quotes for Paer.dk

get.description:
Liveness + DB connectivity probe.

App Runner's health check treats any non-200 as unhealthy and will pull the
instance from the load balancer after the configured unhealthy threshold.
Returning 503 when the DB is unreachable is what we want — better to fail
closed than keep routing traffic to a pod that can't persist quotes.

Complete corridor catalog in one call.

On the sell side: the two currencies Paer accepts as source (EUR, DKK)
and the pay-in rail(s) for each.

On the buy side: every currency we can quote against, each with one or
more destination-country entries, and an optional `other_country_fallback`
describing what happens if the customer wants the currency paid into a
bank outside that currency's native country (routed via SWIFT).

`bfi_partner` is intentionally absent from this response — which Circle
BFI partner routes which corridor is not customer-facing information.

Direct mid-market rate lookup. Not used in quote creation (quotes
compute their own mid + spread) — exposed for debugging + reference.

schema.title: Response Get Rate V1 Fx Rate Get

post.description:
Request a live FX quote.

Body contract:
- `sell_currency` + `buy_currency` — required, 3-letter ISO 4217.
- Exactly ONE of `sell_amount` / `buy_amount` (422 otherwise).
- `destination_country` + `payout_method` — optional; see `GET /v1/fx/corridors`.

Authentication is optional. Quotes created without an API key can be
inspected but not accepted (rule 5). Authenticated quotes are tied to
the caller's `company_id` and `user_id` (via paer-user-api introspection)
and can be accepted by any A/B-role user from the same company.

get.description:
Fetch a quote by ID.

`status` reflects real-time state — a quote stored as `"live"` whose
`expires_at` has passed returns `"expired"` here (the DB transition
happens lazily on the next accept attempt; this read does not mutate).

post.description:
Accept a live quote.

Role gates (paer-user-api):
  - C-role caller: 403 view_only_role_cannot_accept
  - A-role caller: solo authority — applies immediately (200)
  - B-role caller: signature recorded; quote stays in
    `pending_signatures` (response code 202) until a second distinct
    A or B from the same company also calls this endpoint.

Idempotency-Key scope: keyed by `(idempotency_key, user_id, company_id)`.
A retry from a different device (same user, different api key) hits the cache.

get.description: Full drill-down on a single quote for debugging / issue investigation.

sell_currency.title: Sell Currency
sell_currency.description: Source currency (ISO 4217, 3-letter). Must be DKK or EUR — Paer's limited PI license only permits these two as source.

buy_currency.title: Buy Currency
buy_currency.description: Destination currency (ISO 4217, 3-letter). See `GET /v1/fx/corridors` for the full supported list.

sell_amount.title: Sell Amount
sell_amount.description: Amount to SELL, denominated in `sell_currency`. **Provide EXACTLY ONE of `sell_amount` or `buy_amount`.** Range: 0.01 to 999,999,999.

buy_amount.title: Buy Amount
buy_amount.description: Amount to BUY, denominated in `buy_currency`. **Provide EXACTLY ONE of `sell_amount` or `buy_amount`.** Range: 0.01 to 999,999,999.

destination_country.title: Destination Country
destination_country.description: Beneficiary bank's country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Optional. If omitted, defaults to the native country of `buy_currency` (e.g. US for USD). Pass a non-native country to route via SWIFT for off-country holdings (e.g. INR held at a UK bank: set `destination_country=GB`).

payout_method.title: Payout Method
payout_method.description: Specific payout rail code. Optional. If omitted, the fastest rail for the corridor is used. See `GET /v1/fx/corridors` for valid codes per (buy_currency, destination_country). Examples: `PIX` (BRL/BR), `SPEI` (MXN/MX), `IMPS` (INR/IN), `RTP` (USD/US), `SWIFT` (off-country fallback).

QuoteCreate.title: QuoteCreate
QuoteCreate.description:
Body for `POST /v1/quotes`.

Required fields: `sell_currency`, `buy_currency`, AND **exactly one** of
`sell_amount` or `buy_amount`. Omitting both or providing both returns 422.

Optional fields: `destination_country` (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), `payout_method`
(see `GET /v1/fx/corridors` for valid codes per corridor).
